title: Rho footer
description: A near-black footer opened by one huge word in a dotted, LED-like texture across the full column, then a wordmark with social links, four columns of mono-headed links (the last with contact lines and two app badges), a hairline, and long paragraphs of small legal print. Links turn mint on hover.
notes: the big dotted word is SVG text filled with a dot pattern, stretched to the column's width
backdrop: anything behind the footer (the original has a WebGL starfield); empty: nothing
name: rho-footer

props.name: bigWord
props.description: the huge dotted word at the top (keep it short: 5–8 letters)

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, set as a wordmark

props.name: socials
props.description: social links under (desktop) or beside (phones) the wordmark

props.name: contact
props.description: the contact column: a heading and plain lines (phone, email, address)

props.name: badges
props.description: app-store style badges under the contact lines

props.name: backdrop
props.description: anything behind the footer; empty: nothing
